title: Class script randomly unsaves
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in godot 4.5-stable, unkown wether this is reproducible in other versions

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot 4.5-stable - Forward+ - Snapdragon X chipset (Integrated graphics) 

### Issue description

Sometimes, a specific script class i made for my player, disappears from godot's context window (it's still in the file system but godot seems to forget this file was saved and becomes "File(unsaved).gd") making the console spew out a couple of errors:

```
  ERROR: res://addons/gravity_character_plugin/scenes/player_scene/Player.tscn::GDScript_ipr6g:4 - Parse Error: Class "BaseStat" hides a global script class.
```

``` 
 ERROR: Resource file not found: res:// (expected type: unknown)
```

Then, after trying to reopen the script a couple of times from the file system, godot seems to recognize again the file, and after deleting and discarding the "unsaved" files it spawned in the script editor, it "fixes" itself right after prompting in the console the following errors:

``` 
  ERROR: Resource file not found: res:// (expected type: unknown)
  ERROR: Resource file not found: res:// (expected type: GDScript)
  ERROR: Resource file not found: res:// (expected type: GDScript)
``` 

After this it's okay until it randomly happens again (usually after reopening the editor).

Sidenote: Once godot said in the error prompt (the one below the open script) while keeping the bugged script open that this was a bug and to report this on github as an issue but i couldn't reproduce this since then.

### Steps to reproduce

Unfortunately all i can say is trying to open different class scripts (scripts with class_name on top) because i couldn't manage to make a minimal reproduction project actually reproduce this error as it seems to be a really slippery bug.

I also triple checked it wasn't an issue generated from other script of stuff i'm working on but everything seems to work as intended and nothing is really interfering with that.
